description: This Java source file defines the ApplyCouponFlow class responsible for applying coupon codes within the promotions service. It includes methods for validating, normalizing, and applying coupons, as well as handling related exceptions. The class orchestrates the process of retrieving coupon details from the repository, validating their active status, and calculating discounts based on the request.

classes.name: ApplyCouponFlow
classes.description: A service class providing the canonical flow for applying coupons, including validation, retrieval, and discount calculation logic.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Main method to apply a coupon based on the request, orchestrating validation, retrieval, validation of coupon activity, discount calculation, and result formation.

methods.name: validateAmounts
methods.description: Validates the input request to ensure all necessary fields are provided and non-negative.

methods.name: ensureCouponActiveNow
methods.description: Checks if the coupon is active and within its validity period based on current time.

methods.name: normalizeCode
methods.description: Normalizes coupon code strings by trimming and converting to uppercase for case-insensitive lookup.

methods.name: safeUpper
methods.description: Normalizes optional currency strings to uppercase; returns null if input is null.
